question: What was the first mammal extinction blamed on climate change, and what exactly finished it?
answer: The Bramble Cay melomys, a small rodent found only on a coral cay of a few hectares in the Torres Strait, about 3 m high. Storm surges on higher seas washed over the island again and again, stripping the plants it ate. It was last seen in 2009; Australia declared it extinct in 2019.
move: The smallest range goes first when the edge moves.
ask: What small, narrow thing of mine would be the first to go if conditions shifted?
reference: Gynther, Waller & Leung, Confirmation of the extinction of the Bramble Cay melomys Melomys rubicola on Bramble Cay, Torres Strait, Queensland Government, 2016
